name: Moshimo Ashita ga Hare Naraba
original_name: もしも明日が晴れならば
source:
To Hatoba Kazuki, Nonosaki Akiho had been an irreplaceable being. For as far as when she and her sister, after the loss of their parents, were taken in long ago, she had taken the role of his big sister, his mother, his sweetheart. To him, the loss of her figure meant the world had crumbled down, for him who had managed to gather up courage and confess, days before summer break.

A couple of months later, as the pain of parting still remained vivid, the ghost of Akiho appears before his eyes, save little for warning. "I still had memories left here", she said softly, a soft smile attached to her face.

[Adapted from [url=http://www.h5.dion.ne.jp/~jade/]jadeの小部屋[/url]]
translation:
对鸠羽一树而言，野乃崎明穗是无可替代的存在。很久以前，明穗与妹妹在双亲去世后被一树家收养。从那时起，她既像一树的姐姐，也像他的母亲，更是他的心上人。就在暑假前几天，一树终于鼓起勇气向她表白；然而明穗的离世，却令他的整个世界彻底崩塌。

几个月后，离别的痛楚依然鲜明。毫无预兆地，明穗的幽灵出现在一树眼前。“因为我还有未了的心愿。”她带着温柔的微笑，轻声说道。

[改编自[url=http://www.h5.dion.ne.jp/~jade/]jade的小屋[/url]]
